items.headline: Essex Police secure more than 200 shop theft charges in a fortnight as retailers report more
items.summary: Fifty people were charged in two weeks across the county, many of them in court the next day.
body: Officers secured more than 202 shop theft charges against 50 people in a fortnight, Essex Police said on Thursday. Many of those charged went before magistrates the following day, and some were convicted and sentenced straight away.

Sergeant Christian Denning, of the force's Business Crime Team, put the quick results down to shops reporting more thefts, good-quality CCTV and witness statements, and fast investigations by officers.

The force said many shoplifters steal to pay for drug or alcohol addictions. People arrested for shop theft and similar crimes can be tested for Class A drugs in custody, and those who test positive are referred to treatment, while officers work with partner agencies on health and housing to cut repeat offending.
points: Business Crime Team works with shops on prevention and security
